## Minutes  
### 1. Risk Appetite Statement Review  
**Summary:**
CRO presented 2026 Risk Appetite Statement (updated since 2025).  
**Key Metrics:**
- Capital Ratio Target: >15% (actual: 18.2%)
- Operational Loss Tolerance: <£50k/year (actual YTD: £8.2k)
- Credit Loss Ratio: <0.5% (actual: 0.2%)
- Compliance Violations: Zero tolerated (actual: 0)  
**Committee Decision:**
✅ **APPROVED** 2026 Risk Appetite Statement as presented.  
**Action Items:**
- CRO to communicate Risk Appetite to business units (by March 31)
- CFO to embed capital targets in budget process (by April 15)  
---
header_path: FirstUK Bank — Board Risk Committee Meeting Minutes > Minutes > 1. Risk Appetite Statement Review

### 2. Q4 2025 Risk Dashboard & KRIs  
**Summary:**
CRO presented quarterly risk dashboard covering operational, credit, compliance, and technology risks.  
**Key Findings:**  
| KRI | Target | Q4 2025 | Trend |
|-----|--------|---------|-------|
| System Availability | 99.8% | 99.85% | ✅ Above |
| Fraud Detection Rate | 97% | 97.1% | ✅ Above |
| Reconciliation Errors | <1 per day | 0.8 per day | ✅ Below |
| AML False Positives | <2% | 1.8% | ✅ Below |
| Account Opening Errors | <0.5% | 0.3% | ✅ Below |  
**Committee Observation:**
- Strong operational performance across KRIs
- System availability improvement from Q3 (99.8% → 99.85%)
- Fraud detection performing well despite increased transaction volume  
**No Exceptions Raised:** All KRIs within acceptable range.  
---
header_path: FirstUK Bank — Board Risk Committee Meeting Minutes > Minutes > 2. Q4 2025 Risk Dashboard & KRIs

name: Chunk 7/15
text:
### 3. Capital Adequacy & Stress Testing  
**Summary:**
CFO presented capital position and 2026 stress testing scenarios.  
**Current Capital Position:**
- Capital Ratio: 18.2% (Pillar 1: 15% minimum)
- Capital Buffer: 3.2% above minimum
- Assessment: **Comfortable position**, no capital raising needed 2026  
**Stress Testing Scenarios (2026 Plan):**
1. **Recession Scenario:** 2% economic contraction
- Expected capital impact: -2.1% (ratio falls to 16.1%)
- Assessment: **Resilient**, still above minimum  
2. **Fraud Shock:** £250k fraud incident
- Expected capital impact: -0.3% (ratio falls to 17.9%)
- Assessment: **Manageable**, standard reserves sufficient  
3. **Operational Loss:** Major system outage, customer losses
- Expected capital impact: -0.8% (ratio falls to 17.4%)
- Assessment: **Absorbed**, recovery plan documented  
**Committee Decision:**
✅ **APPROVED** 2026 stress testing plan.  
**Action Items:**
- CFO to conduct stress tests by end of Q2 2026
- Report findings to committee in June 2026 meeting  
---
header_path: FirstUK Bank — Board Risk Committee Meeting Minutes > Minutes > 3. Capital Adequacy & Stress Testing

### 4. Regulatory Updates (FCA Circulars)  
**Summary:**
Head of Compliance briefed committee on FCA Circulars issued in Q1 2026.  
**Key Circulars:**
1. **FCA-COBS-2026-03:** Enhanced KYC for high-risk customers
- Deadline: March 1, 2026 (enforcement date)
- Status: **Compliant** (procedures updated, staff trained)
- Action: Ongoing monitoring of implementation effectiveness  
2. **FCA-OP-2026-01:** Open Banking API extension
- Deadline: June 30, 2026
- Status: **In Progress** (development on track)
- Action: CTO to report in June 2026 meeting  
3. **FCA-OPER-2026-04:** Operational Resilience standards
- Deadline: Ongoing (best practice)
- Status: **Compliant** (RTO/RPO meet expectations)
- Action: Annual documentation review in Q4 2026  
**Committee Observation:**
- FirstUK Bank responding well to regulatory changes
- No anticipated breaches or compliance issues
- Recommend continued proactive monitoring  
---

**Fraud Metrics:**
- Fraud incidents: 5 (all detected and blocked)
- Fraud prevented: ~£47,000
- Customer reimbursement: £0 (all customers had zero liability)
- Detection rate: 97.1%  
**AML/KYC Metrics:**

**Committee Assessment:**

- No compliance violations detected

name: Chunk 11/15
text:
### 7. Technology Risk Assessment  
**Summary:**
CTO presented technology risk assessment including cybersecurity posture and system availability.  
**Key Risks Identified:**  
**Risk 1: Legacy Payment System** ⚠️ **Medium Risk**
- System is 7 years old, periodic slowness
- Mitigation: Replacement project planned 2027
- Status: Monitoring and optimization
- Impact if failure: 1–2 hour payment processing delay  
**Risk 2: Third-Party Vendor Reliance** 🟢 **Low Risk**
- Dependent on AWS for cloud infrastructure
- Mitigation: Multi-region backup, vendor SLAs
- Status: Quarterly vendor reviews ongoing
- Impact: Well-mitigated  
**Risk 3: Cybersecurity Threat Landscape** 🟡 **Emerging**
- Increased phishing attacks (industry-wide)
- Mitigation: Staff training, advanced email filtering
- Status: Monitoring external threat intelligence
- Impact: Low (strong controls in place)  
**Committee Decision:**
✅ **APPROVED** technology risk assessment.  
**Recommendation:**
- Accelerate legacy payment system replacement (tentatively 2027 → early 2027)
- Continue cybersecurity investment and awareness training  
---
